channels.name: Sussy's Cakes Recipes
channels.description: Sussan Apeh, a Lagos-based, professionally trained cake artist, pastry chef and small chops specialist with a Business Administration degree (Babcock University). Primarily a recipe/technique channel, but runs paid 24/7 online business training alongside it and has at least one video specifically on 'how to start up a catering business at low cost'.
channels.focus: Baking/confectionery technique, with a genuine but secondary business thread
channels.verificationMethod: Fetched the channel page directly. Flagged honestly: unlike most channels counted this session, this one's primary content is recipes/technique, not business — included because the business thread is real (credentials, paid training, an explicit business-focused video) and no cleaner Nigeria-specific business-of-catering channel surfaced.

notes: Real, rich Nigeria-specific business content exists in BLOG form (WithinNigeria's detailed 'Complete Guide to Starting a Catering Business in Nigeria for Owambe Events' is genuinely excellent — equipment costs, logistics, owambe-specific menu economics) but its RSS feed could not be confirmed this round. Worth a direct check of withinnigeria.com before the next pass. Free-book search not yet done this round.
